facts.fact: 节目开始于 Friday, June 12, 2009——美国模拟电视转数字广播的法定切换夜。
facts.anchor: My TV show starts on Friday, June 12, 2009, the night of the analog-to-digital switch-off.

facts.fact: 当晚挚友 David 和 Erin 在地下室办两人 kegger，用的是从 Erin 妈妈酒柜里“借”来的一瓶 Tito's，轮流对饮等模拟广播终结。
facts.anchor: The best friends stayed up late that night, throwing themselves a two-person kegger in the basement with a bottle of Tito’s they “borrowed” from Erin’s mom’s liquor cabinet.

facts.fact: 十一点半左右（around eleven-thirty），David 起身架设他的 Canon VIXIA 摄像机，想拍下切换瞬间。
facts.anchor: Around eleven-thirty, David stumbled to his feet and got to work setting up his Canon VIXIA.

facts.fact: David 对着镜头宣布时间为 11:58 p.m., June twelfth, 2009，并称这是自登月（Man on the Moon）、柏林墙倒塌以来电视史上最大的时刻。
facts.anchor: It’s 11:58 p.m., June twelfth, 2009. And this is the biggest moment in television history since the Man on the Moon. The Fall of the Berlin Wall.

facts.fact: David 说模拟电视上最后一个播出的节目是 Sex and the City，并骂它是 “The lamest show ever”。
facts.anchor: And the last thing ever broadcast on analog television was…” David looks behind him. “Sex and the fucking City. The lamest show ever!

facts.fact: GlobalVill.com 上已有别人抢先上传的切换录像：JakeMonster 上传的 “The Exact Moment that Analog Broadcasting Ended!” 和 triggerhappyninja 上传的 “Analog TV is Over You Guys!”——David 因 Erin 家平庸的 DSL 连接被人抢先（scooped）。
facts.anchor: Some videos are already up on GlobalVill.com. “The Exact Moment that Analog Broadcasting Ended!” uploaded by JakeMonster. “Analog TV is Over You Guys!” uploaded by triggerhappyninja. David’s been scooped, beaten to the punch thanks to Erin’s mediocre DSL connection.

facts.fact: David 和 Erin 接吻，持续了十四秒（也许十五秒），之后 David 退缩（chickens out）。
facts.anchor: The kiss lasts fourteen seconds, maybe fifteen, before David chickens out.

facts.fact: 那个周一 Erin 根本没有来上学：没请病假，而且自周五晚之后，她其他的朋友都没有她的消息。
facts.anchor: In fact, Erin will never show up to school on Monday at all. She won’t call out sick, and none of her other friends will have heard from her since Friday night.
